item1.title: Marafiq completes maintenance of key water pipeline in muscat
item1.intro: Marafiq successfully completed the scheduled maintenance of a major water pipeline in Muscat, ensuring uninterrupted and enhancing network reliability.
item1.para1: The maintenance work, which was carried out over the weekend, is part of Marafiq's ongoing commitment to delivering reliable and high-quality services to the communities we serve.
item1.para2: Our teams worked around the clock to complete the tasks safely and efficiently, minimizing any impact on customers.
item1.quoteText: This maintenance is part of our proactive approach to infrastructure management, ensuring the long-term sustainability and resilience of our water network.
item1.outro: Marafiq continues to invest in the development and maintenance of critical infrastructure to support Oman's growth and the well-being of its people.

item2.title: Marafiq Successfully Concludes Duqm Economic Forum 2025
item2.intro: Marafiq proudly participated in and successfully concluded the Duqm Economic Forum 2025, reaffirming its commitment to Oman's economic development agenda.
item2.para1: The forum brought together key stakeholders from the public and private sectors to explore investment opportunities and infrastructure development strategies across the Duqm Special Economic Zone.
item2.para2: Marafiq's delegation presented the company's strategic roadmap and ongoing projects, highlighting the vital role of reliable utilities in attracting and sustaining investment.
item2.quoteText: Our participation in this forum reflects our strategic vision to be a catalyst for economic growth and a reliable partner for development initiatives across Oman.
item2.outro: The forum concluded with a series of strategic agreements that will pave the way for expanded utility services in the region.

item3.title: Marafiq Supports National Forum on Child Development and Inclusion
item3.intro: As part of its corporate social responsibility initiatives, Marafiq extended its support to the National Forum on Child Development and Inclusion.
item3.para1: The forum focused on policies and practices that promote the holistic development of children, with particular attention to those with special needs.
item3.para2: Marafiq's involvement underscores its commitment to building a more equitable and inclusive society in Oman, supporting community wellbeing beyond its core utility services.
item3.quoteText: Marafiq believes that investing in future generations is one of the most important contributions a company can make to society.
item3.outro: Through sponsorship and active participation, Marafiq demonstrated its alignment with Oman Vision 2040, which places human capital and inclusive growth at the heart of national progress.

item5.title: Marafiq Partners with IEEE at Key Forum to Accelerate Oman's Development
item5.intro: Marafiq has partnered with IEEE to drive innovation and accelerate Oman's development.
item5.para1: The partnership focuses on applying cutting-edge engineering standards to the utility sector.
item5.para2: Both organisations will collaborate on capacity building, knowledge exchange, and joint research initiatives.
item5.quoteText: This partnership will open new horizons for technological advancement in the utility sector.
item5.outro: The collaboration aims to enhance service delivery and contribute to Oman's digital transformation goals.

hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Get to know us more
hero.description: Marafiq's is Oman's leading provider of essential utilities and municipal services, committed to powering communities and enhancing quality of life.

overview.whoPara1: Marafiq (Muscat Electricity Distribution Company SAOG) was established in 2004 and is listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange. We are responsible for the generation, desalination, transmission, distribution and supply of electricity and water, and the collection and treatment of wastewater in the Governorates of Muscat and Al Batinah.
overview.whoPara2: We are dedicated to delivering reliable and sustainable services through continuous innovation, operational excellence and a customer-centric approach.
overview.taglineSub: Delivering essential services today, building a sustainable tomorrow.
